#include <iostream>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <cstring>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long v;
long long cand[17];

int rec(int ind, long long val) {
    val = abs(val);
    if (ind == 0) {
        return val;
    }
    int a1 = val / cand[ind];
    int a2 = a1+1;
    return min(a1*(ind+1) + rec(ind-1, val-a1*cand[ind]), a2*(ind+1) + rec(ind-1, val-a2*cand[ind]));
}

int main(){
    cin >> v;
    cand[0] = 1;
    for(int i = 1; i < 17; i++) {
        cand[i] = cand[i-1]*10 + 1;
    }
    cout << rec(16, v) << endl;
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
